review_text: Mori & Mill has a cozy and elegant atmosphere that's perfect for relaxing with friends or family. The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented, while the drinks were equally enjoyable. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel welcome throughout our visit. Overall, a wonderful dining experience, and I'd definitely come back to try more of the menu. Highly recommended!

"If you're looking for good food + good feels, Mori and Mill delivers. Everything we ordered was delicious, service was quick and friendly, and the place just has that 'stay a little longer' energy. 5 stars!" ✨

I visited this cafe when it has just opened in Davao and based on my experience, the whole thing would have been nicer if there is a better parking space and the staff would have been more attentive. It was new and it was nice but it really does not give you a reason to keep coming back since the food we ordered did not really leave a mark. The owners seem pretty nice and the staff they have really tried to be more attentive but maybe it is just the busyness of the place that made it seem that they cannot accommodate us properly.

Don't get scammed by the advertisement of this restaurant you'll definitely get disappointed. Aesthetics of the restaurant is the total opposite of service and food. We dined last night. We have lots of left over food, we didn't opted to take it home since the food was undercooked. Service is very poor and toilet room is disgustingly untidy. We definitely regret bringing our Non Davao friends here. Experience was embarassing. I almost forgot, their FB page sends you a link to their website to book a reservation. Upon arrival on the resto, staff says they didn't get our reservation.

I had high expectations for Mori & Mill, but unfortunately it didn't live up to them. The food was just so-so, especially considering the price point—I expected much better quality and flavors. The biggest disappointment was the ube gelato. It seemed to contain an excessive amount of food coloring, and even several days later, my lips are still stained purple. I hope they can improve both the food quality and the ingredients they use.
While the staff was incredibly accommodating, the overall experience (food espcially) felt overpriced and a bit overhyped

A True Taste of Manila Quality! The food here is absolutely magnificent...honestly, nothing like I've ever tasted before. If you've been searching for that high-caliber, vibrant dining experience you usually only find in Manila's top food spots, Mori and Mill is exactly where you need to be. Beyond the incredible menu, the vibe and atmosphere are unmatched. It's the perfect all-rounder spot whether you're bringing family, catching up with friends, or hosting colleagues. It genuinely feels like a place where you can pause, take a breath, and just slow down to enjoy a spectacular meal with the people who matter most. Highly, highly recommended!
one of the best salmons ive tasted here in davao!!! also their dubai chewy had chocolate mousse in it so it also had a unique flavor that everyone cant miss out on 💯💯
The place was packed because it's newly opened. The food was decent, but I found it a bit pricey for the amount of food served. Overall, it was okay.

It wasn't good, it's ordinary and overpriced. Servers are all over the place and very slow. It is very inconvenient to order in an iPad considering they have service charge, in the end the customer do all the service. Biggest ick the bathroom, I cant even. Just a one hit wonder i won't recommend.
First of all, I'd leave 0 stars but it's not possible so here's a 1. Beef noodle soup was so salty I turned into a raisin. Mori and mill? More like less and not a good meal.
Approachable staff, good experience, very inviting and welcoming, very accommodating. Will go back again with my mom.
Good coffee and relaxing interiors, definitely would come back for another cup.
Food cold, had to ask 3 times just to get some water. Like bruh...

I really wanted to enjoy my dining experience here because the restaurant has a nice ambiance and the food is on the pricier side, so I expected good service. Unfortunately, our visit was disappointing due to several mistakes. First, I was served the wrong pasta. I had already been given my utensils and was about to take my first bite when one of the waiters approached me and informed me that the pasta served was not actually the one I had ordered. I'm glad they caught the mistake before I ate it, but it was still an avoidable error. Second, we were given the wrong bill. Our total was just a little over ₱2,000, but the first bill presented to us was around ₱3,500. Had I not checked the receipt carefully, I could have ended up paying for someone else's order. This was the most concerning part of the experience. Lastly, there was inconsistent information regarding their promotion. Upon entering, one staff member informed us that customers who spent ₱2,000 would receive a free promotional cup. Since our bill exceeded that amount, I asked to claim it after our meal. However, another staff member told me that the minimum spend was actually ₱2,500. It was disappointing to receive conflicting information from the staff. I understand that mistakes happen, but experiencing three separate issues in one visit made it difficult to overlook. For a restaurant with premium pricing, I expected better accuracy, communication, and overall service. I hope this feedback helps the team improve, because the restaurant has potential, but our experience today fell short of expectations.

Came in to order some matchas and other snacks. For my credentials, I've been to almost every major matcha cafes in town and I frequently make my own matchas at home for the past 3 years. Their matcha was disappointing to say the least. Both the matcha cloud and matcha latte were watery, pale-looking, and flavorless with very little depth. The matcha cloud in particular had a bad aftertaste from their choice of coconut water. The gelatos were also melted even while still being stored in the chiller display. For the price they are charging, you can absolutely take your money elsewhere. Don't be fooled by some of the friends and relatives leaving 5 star reviews on here to try and mask the low ratings on this place :)
Experience was decent! I suggest making reservations during lunch hours due to high demand 😵 💫 it was so cramped and seating was tight, with us nearly 10 inches from other customers.

Not worth the price. If you're a vlogger, yes the place is very nice. But if you're there to enjoy food, it's a big no How simple it is to make a carbonara and yet they found a way to ruin it. Egg tart too sweet. Side dish french fries is street vendor level fries.
The matcha's good best in davao 10/10

We ordered the truffle pasta, but it was quite bland and we could barely taste the truffle. The matcha had a strange blue layer on top that had already hardened when it was served. It made the drink difficult to stir and sip, and it also affected the taste. The shawarma nachos were not crunchy at all. They would have been much better if the chips had been fried or served fresh and crisp. Overall, there wasn't anything particularly memorable about the dish. The breaded pork was flavorful, but it came with too little sauce—just enough for a bite or two—leaving the rest of the dish dry. The "Dubai" kataifi was unfortunately very soggy instead of light and crispy, which was disappointing given the texture you'd expect from kataifi. Despite these issues, the café itself is very aesthetic though the place is a bit cramped. The coffee was also good, which helped make the overall experience better. With some improvements to the food, this place has a lot of potential. Food was definitely on the pricey side.
Yummy food. Love the truffle pasta, caesar salad, beef shawarma ❤️🥰

A little cramped. Their turn Gelato is so melted, it tastes like banana smoothie. I do not recommend this, try Vanilla Gelato instead. Salmon is good, aside from the bone we found, and soggy skin. Loco burger steak is good, as well as mushroom soup. Ube Crack is not that good.
The food is okay but it seems overpriced. Moreover, they take 9% service charge for a small service.
We ate here for my birthday lunch! The food was super good (especially the bahn mi quesadilla!). The service was good as well, the waiters are attentive and polite.

i ate lunch here with family friends a couple days ago and it wasn't really as good as i thought it would be for several reasons. food: it's a hit or miss for the meals and some dishes are a bit pricey for the serving size. i can't speak for the pastries and coffee since i didn't try them. • baked farfalle noodles were not cooked enough so it was hard. it's serving size was also small compared to other pasta dishes and their prices. baked farfalle was only ₱569 but the plate was so small compared to the prawn linguini which was bigger and for ₱559. • prawn linguini was a bit too salty. • beef shawarma vegetable was dry and had very little beef. • breakfast pork char siu genuinely looks and tastes like tocino so i don't think ₱485 was worth it. service: the waiters seemed too busy to accommodate us properly. • a waiter just handed us the tablets but they didn't even demonstrate how to navigate and order using the tablet. • we didn't have enough utensils on our table. • we had to ask for the water AND the glass. atmosphere: parking is awful. AC didn't ventilate the place well and there wasn't enough room for the waiters to even move around properly and serve food to other people without bumping into each other. • the leather seats by the wall is like the hot spot of the restaurant because it had no AC unless that's something you'd prefer. • a lot of waiters seem to just be idle either by the back of the kitchen or around the "coffee/bar area" which makes it feel so crowded inside. • i don't know why the parking is set up to be like a box so it's super hard to get in and get out. i think diagonal parking would be better but i'm not an expert at that. again, i really can't speak for the other things in their menu, particularly the coffee and pastries but my lunch was a bit disappointing because it was pricey for the size and the quality. i think you pay more for the ambience than what the dishes are actually worth. :')

Food was not good, just average, I guess. Matcha was very disappointing, felt like 80% ice and water and just a shot of the actual drink - very watered down. Dessert was alright. They did deliver the food quite fast, but bill out was very slow and they seemed to be having trouble with their system. Place was okay and aesthetically pleasing. They have this gimmick where you order food from a tablet - add the item you want to order to a cart and then checkout. I think they may have put too much resource into that gimmick rather the quality of the food. Will probably not go back here again nor recommend to friends, mostly because of the food. Ordered the Hummus, the sausage appetizer, the shawarma bowl, cold matcha drink, a tart, and the dara.

Idk if its homophobia or purely elitism, either way its bad considering you're in the business who gives service to your customers. The food, sure, its good. Would i come back and reccommend it, i won't. Also your toilet stinks.
